restaurantName: Bai Nian Hun Tun Lao Dian
address: 12-13 Beitouqiao East Alley, Longwan, Wenzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: Without bells and whistles, this century-old wonton shop appeals to gourmets with its heritage vibe and old-fashioned flavours. It sells only 200 servings of wonton each day; shrimp and pork are wrapped on the spot in translucent ‘skin’ made in-house from scratch. The broth is another highlight – scallion, homemade pork floss, wine-soaked dried shrimps and laver contribute to the layered flavours. Consider adding a chicken egg or duck egg as extra.
pageTitle: Bai Nian Hun Tun Lao Dian
